Title: Azure Cosmos DB capacity planner update

Body.Content:
To continue helping customers fine-tune their Azure Cosmos DB throughput and storage estimations, we've updated the Azure Cosmos DB capacity planner tool with support for document update operations and data storage calculations. 

For more information about Azure Cosmos DB, visit the Azure Cosmos DB page.
